text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Sigh… I'm so nervous… What if I lose again?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I've reviewed my training and tackled the reasons for my losses… I've done everything I could to prepare for today's race.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: The results of the last race were frustrating, but I'm determined to place first today.
choice_data_list: I know you can do it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Thank you! Those who fear the starting gate will never reach the goal, as they say! I'm going to keep that in mind as I run today's race!
